hero.lede: Find services, agencies, forms, holidays and laws — written plainly, updated continuously, and freely open to all. An independent volunteer project.

mostRequested.label: Most requested this week
mostRequested.featureTitle: Renew or apply for a Philippine passport.
mostRequested.featureLede: The plain-language walkthrough for every passport situation — first-time, renewal, lost, minor, senior, and OFW. Updated April 2026.

transparency.label: Where public money goes
transparency.description: The national budget, plainly broken down by department. Every peso accounted for, sourced from the DBM's official publication.

items.heading: Written in plain language
items.body: Every service page is rewritten in plain English and Filipino, free of legalese — with source citations linked at the end.

items.heading: Updated continuously
items.body: Our volunteer editors check every page against the official source at least monthly. Page-level timestamps show the last verified date.

items.heading: Independent & open-source
items.body: Not affiliated with any agency. Every correction, commit, and editorial choice lives openly on GitHub. No ads, no tracking.
